title: Disentangling Test-Time and Parameter Scaling for Cost-Efficient Accuracy Improvements in Agentic Evaluation

contributions.purpose: 把外部 CoT 与模型内部推理能力解耦做受控比较
contributions.mechanism: 在 GSM8K(1319 题)/PopQA(2000 题子集)上交叉 {No-CoT,CoT}×{内部推理开/关}×模型规模(GPT-4.1 系 + Gemini 2.5 系),用 Gemini thinking budget=0 隔离容量效应
contributions.evaluation: 小模型加 CoT 在 GSM8K +49.96pp(OpenAI)/+57.18pp(Gemini);带内部推理的 Gemini Flash 上外部 CoT 95.36%→95.27%(反降且成本 23x)
contributions.domain: LLM 评测 / agentic systems 成本优化
contributions.source_quote: Methodological framework: A controlled comparison isolating external Chain-of-Thought from internal reasoning to identify when they are substitutable versus complementary.

contributions.purpose: 量化准确率-成本-延迟三方权衡
contributions.mechanism: 逐样本记录 token/成本/延迟,定义 cost-per-percentage-point(ΔC/ΔA)并画 Pareto 前沿
contributions.evaluation: GSM8K 上 Gemini 参数扩展每 +1pp 仅 7.02e-7 美元,比加 CoT(3.94e-6)约 5.6x 更省;PopQA 上参数扩展全面占优
contributions.source_quote: Cost-latency analysis: Comprehensive logging of per-sample costs and latencies alongside accuracy, with metrics for cost-per-percentage-point improvements and Pareto frontier analysis.

contributions.purpose: 给出任务感知的部署策略
contributions.mechanism: 由 H1-H3 假设检验结果归纳五条实践建议:先小模型、优先参数扩展、高级模型避免外部 CoT、按任务选择性用推理、领域路由
contributions.evaluation: 知识型 QA 上 CoT 使带推理模型一致降准:GPT-4.1 49.55%→44.55%、Gemini 2.5 Pro 45.60%→40.33%
contributions.source_quote: Deployment guidance: Evidence-based recommendations for practitioners: prioritize parameter scaling initially, then apply reasoning techniques selectively based on task characteristics.

self_declared_provenance.quote: Our approach extends this line of work by providing systematic cost-per-improvement metrics and Pareto frontier analysis for strategic decision-making.
Our work leverages these capabilities where available to isolate the effects of reasoning from token generation overhead.

notes: 核心即负结果/trade-off:对带内部推理的模型,外部 CoT 冗余甚至有害(GSM8K 95.36%→95.27% 而成本 23x;PopQA 三个模型降 1.8-5.3pp)。自认局限:PopQA 仅 2000 子集、因 API 不稳排除 self-consistency、内部推理开关仅 Gemini 可用、无置信区间(checklist 统计显著性答 No)。AI 披露详实:hypothesis [D]、实验代码 [C](自述初版 AI 代码产出'implausible results','vibe coding'修不好,人工 root-cause)、分析 [B]、写作 [D](第四轮迭代起改动开始诱发幻觉);Observed Limitations 自述 AI 过度自信、把未完成 run 当完成。
